name: BT Volume Isosurface Rendering
definition: A volume representation format and rendering technique that approximates an arbitrary reconstruction filter with a set of cubic Bezier Tetrahedra (BT). It renders exact isosurfaces directly inside a pixel shader via local ray tracing within tetrahedral bounding boxes, avoiding triangle mesh generation and supporting arbitrary isosurface levels and high-quality reconstruction filtering.
summary: BT Volume Isosurface Rendering is a real-time technique that renders exact isosurfaces from volumetric data by performing local ray tracing within cubic Bezier Tetrahedra on the GPU.
